title: Mesh shader crash fixed: Layout consistency issue identified and resolved
implementation_summary: Reverted layout transitions back to GENERAL to prevent mesh shader mode crash
Fixed finalBarrier.newLayout from SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL back to GENERAL
Updated oldLayout tracking to expect GENERAL layout from previous frames
Application now runs continuously in mesh shader mode without crashing

key_fixes_implemented.rationale: Mesh shader pipeline expects GENERAL layout for storage access
Must match the final layout from previous mip generation
